title: Shipping quote
description: Generated from the checkout service's QuoteResponse type (checkout 4.2, `make schema`); do not edit by hand, changes start in the checkout repository. The checkout validates every quote it receives from shipquote against this schema and refuses a quote that does not match: the customer then sees no shipping price and cannot pay.

totalCents.description: The sum of the lines' amountCents.

line.description: One charge of the shipment. Shipping charges are never negative: vouchers and discounts are applied by the checkout to the order total, after shipping is quoted, and never appear in a shipping quote.
